description: Named as the caller. Not in the room.
name: Ambrose Kettleby

description: Said the old man, the two younger men, and the play between them.
name: George Bryan

description: Named as the lord who is coming. Not in the room.
name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon

description: Said you play it as licensed, and stopped.
name: John Heminges

description: Reported the call, and added nothing after Heminges.
name: William Shakespeare
